scripts.build: npm run build -w @squeaky/shared && npm run build -w @squeaky/client && npm run build -w @squeaky/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @squeaky/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @squeaky/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
